changes.comment: The Inspector (developer tools) is easier to read: the file you select opens in a column on the right, or slides in from the right when the pane is narrow, so it is never below the table; the table's key is now the row of state chips above it, which also filter; rows come worst first; and every state is named by what is pending, with a sentence explaining it.
The Inspector uses the same colours as the sync icon: amber for pending, grey for offline, red only when a note has diverged.
Each shared folder in the Inspector says in one line whether its saved settings agree with the live session, instead of listing both for you to compare.

From the Inspector you can open a file's note, open its detail in its own tab, and copy a text report of one file or of every row for a bug report. With developer tools on, the sync icon's card offers “Inspect this note”.
The format bar, the Note menu's floating strip and the word count no longer float over the Inspector, Log and Shared views, or over an empty tab; they return when a note is focused.
